networkExporters.stage.fetching.description: Export progress while retrieving stored interviews.

networkExporters.stage.formatting.description: Export progress while preparing session data for export.

networkExporters.stage.generating.description: Export progress while creating CSV or GraphML files.

networkExporters.stage.outputting.description: Export progress while writing the completed export files.

networkExporters.warning.columnRenamed.d.defaultMessage: Some columns would have had the same name as another column in the same file. So that no answers are lost, each was written under a numbered name instead. The renamed columns are:
networkExporters.warning.columnRenamed.d.description: Explanation in the warning shown after an export, followed by a list of the columns that were renamed. A column is one field of the exported data, such as a variable’s answers.

networkExporters.warning.columnRenamed.f.defaultMessage: In the {format, select, csv {CSV} other {GraphML}} files of {protocolName}, the {entity, select, ego {ego} other {{entityTypeName}}} column “{column}”, from the variable {variable}, was written as “{renamedTo}”.
networkExporters.warning.columnRenamed.f.description: One entry in the list of renamed columns, for a column that holds one part of a variable, such as one option of a multiple-choice question. {format} is the file format: CSV, a spreadsheet format, or GraphML, a network format. {protocolName} is the name of the protocol, the study design a researcher builds. {entity} is “ego” for the column of the interview’s participant, and otherwise the column belongs to {entityTypeName}, the name the researcher gave a kind of person, place, thing or relationship. {column} is the name the column would have had, {variable} the name of the variable it comes from, and {renamedTo} the numbered name it was written under.

networkExporters.warning.columnRenamed.i.defaultMessage: In the {format, select, csv {CSV} other {GraphML}} files of {protocolName}, the {entity, select, ego {ego} other {{entityTypeName}}} column “{column}” was written as “{renamedTo}”.
networkExporters.warning.columnRenamed.i.description: One entry in the list of renamed columns. {format} is the file format: CSV, a spreadsheet format, or GraphML, a network format. {protocolName} is the name of the protocol, the study design a researcher builds. {entity} is “ego” for the column of the interview’s participant, and otherwise the column belongs to {entityTypeName}, the name the researcher gave a kind of person, place, thing or relationship. {column} is the name the column would have had, and {renamedTo} the numbered name it was written under.

networkExporters.warning.columnRenamed.t.defaultMessage: Some columns were given new names
networkExporters.warning.columnRenamed.t.description: Heading of the warning shown after an export when some columns in the exported files were renamed because another column in the same file already had their name.

networkExporters.warning.protocolText.de.defaultMessage: Some of the protocol’s own text contained characters that GraphML cannot store, so they were removed in the GraphML files. The affected text is:
networkExporters.warning.protocolText.de.description: Explanation in the warning shown after an export, followed by a list of the protocol’s names that lost characters in the GraphML files. A protocol is the study design a researcher builds. GraphML is a network file format.

networkExporters.warning.protocolText.it.defaultMessage: {text, select, protocolName {The protocol name “{original}”} nodeTypeName {The node type name “{original}” in {protocolName}} edgeTypeName {The edge type name “{original}” in {protocolName}} other {The column name “{original}” in {protocolName}}}
networkExporters.warning.protocolText.it.description: One entry in the list of protocol text that lost characters in the GraphML files. {text} says which text it is: the protocol’s name, the name of a node type (a kind of person, place or thing in the network), the name of an edge type (a kind of relationship), or the name of a column. {original} is that text as the protocol has it. {protocolName} is the name of the protocol.

networkExporters.warning.protocolText.ti.defaultMessage: Some characters were removed from protocol text in the GraphML files
networkExporters.warning.protocolText.ti.description: Heading of the warning shown after an export when text written in the protocol itself, such as its name or the name of a type, held characters that GraphML files cannot store. GraphML is a network file format.

networkExporters.warning.xmlCharacters.c.description: Name of an interview’s case ID, the identifier the researcher gave the interview, shown in a list of the variables whose answers lost characters.

networkExporters.warning.xmlCharacters.d.defaultMessage: Some answers contained characters that GraphML cannot store, so they were removed from the GraphML files only. The CSV files keep every answer unchanged. The affected interviews and variables are:
networkExporters.warning.xmlCharacters.d.description: Explanation in the warning shown after an export, followed by a list of the interviews and the variables whose answers lost characters in the GraphML files. GraphML is a network file format. CSV is a spreadsheet file format.

networkExporters.warning.xmlCharacters.i.description: One entry in the list of interviews affected by removed characters. {caseId} is the interview’s case ID. {variables} is a list of the names of the variables, joined into a sentence, whose answers lost characters.

networkExporters.warning.xmlCharacters.t.defaultMessage: Some characters were removed from the GraphML files
networkExporters.warning.xmlCharacters.t.description: Heading of the warning shown after an export when some answers held characters that GraphML files cannot store.
